race.comment: MARRON (4) is a two-start maiden who has tackled two richer races so far. Finished sixth on debut at Sandown Lakeside then improved stepping up to 1400m at Geelong last time and was beaten a nose. Fitter again and extra trip looks a plus. Off a low draw and expected to go close. DOUBLET (3) was narrowly beaten at Pakenham synthetic fresh then was fourth at the mile there last time. Has upside and looks the danger. STEAL AWAY (12) is better than last run and gets a chance to atone. BLING BABY (7) just missed this trip when second-up last campaign. Fitter and well placed so can improve sharply here.
